title: Shorts: scripts waiting for review
subtitle: Tick 'approve' (voice + animation can start) or 'needs changes' for each script. Comment on details on that short's PLAN.html page. Every script was revised after the Codex review (2026-11-26); approvals name the script hash.
warning: Nothing is voiced or animated until approved here (Q17). Approving costs about $0.05 of TTS per short. After approving, run: python tools/episodes.py --approve <folder>.

sections.title: Approve (voice + animation can start)

items.title: Approve: FIRST VIDEO, zero-knowledge proofs (long 16:9, 13 beats, ~4:44 + Short 9:16, 5 beats, ~1:01, scripts 169502 / 4c38a0)
items.note: Gossip hook; websites and banks have the same problem; Where's Waldo (placed while the friend looks away); the red card (only the 26 black cards shown); the colour-blind balls; why 'zero knowledge' (he already knew every answer); real systems on signed data; the gossip answer. Long 16:9 + Short 9:16, your narration.
detail: Open: U-ooo gossip set-up, U-ppp terms in your mouth, re-check the Codex rewrites of the card, 'why zero' and Waldo beats

items.title: Approve: Why your own voice sounds strange on a recording (own_voice, 10 beats, ~1:45, script 0f0462)
items.note: Air + bone conduction; the recording is thinner, less bass; plug your ears (louder and bassier); people rated their own unlabelled voice higher; part of the cringe is probably surprise.
detail: Open: U-bb terms, «ավելի ուժեղ ու թավ» (X53)

items.title: Approve: The decoy effect (why a medium popcorn exists mainly to sell you the large) (decoy_popcorn, 10 beats, ~2:07, script 689bc1)
items.note: Small 1x / medium 2x / large 3x popcorn; the subscription decoy (84% vs 32%) as the clean case; the effect is weaker than told; ask what you need and what you will pay.
detail: Open: U-xx «խայծի էֆեկտ», U-zz «ադիբուդի»

items.title: Approve: Short 2: "The test is 99% accurate" (Bayes) (bayes_test, 12 beats, ~2:34, script 573c56)
items.note: 1,000 dots: a positive means 50%, 9% for a rarer disease; many doctors miss it too; a second, independent test gives ~99%, the same test repeated stays at 50%.
detail: Open: U-a address, U-b «սկրինինգ» (now only on the source line), U-d HIV line

items.title: Approve: Map projections (why Greenland looks as big as Africa) (map_projection, 9 beats, ~1:52, script 5d5ccb)
items.note: Africa is 14x Greenland; drag Greenland south, lift Armenia north (area x6); orange peel and Gauss; why Mercator stretched; Web Mercator cut at 85°; switch on globe view in Google Maps.
detail: Open: U-ccc «պրոյեկցիա», U-ddd «Գուգլ քարտեզները»

items.title: Approve: Showcase 2: Friendship paradox (on average, your friends really do have more friends than you) (friendship, 10 beats, ~1:42, script f02fa1)
items.note: 20-person network: friends' friends average ~5 vs 3.6; 17 of 20 here have fewer friends than their friends; popular people sit on many lists; Facebook 93%; flu and vaccination use.
detail: Open: U-s term, U-t hook wording

items.title: Approve: Greek statues were originally painted in bright colours (painted_statues, 9 beats, ~2:02, script 9f8fdd)
items.note: Statues were painted; traces under raking light, UV, and Egyptian blue's infrared glow seen by a camera; the Peplos Kore; why we thought white; Akhtamar; copies are hypotheses.
detail: Open: U-hhh local anchor, U-iii «Պեպլոսով կորե»

items.title: Approve: Showcase 4: Stanislav Petrov, the Soviet officer who treated a 1983 nuclear alarm as false, and was right (petrov, 12 beats, ~2:16, script e33c62)
items.note: 5 missiles on screen; Petrov weighed the alarm against the prior, the new system's reliability and the silent radars; sun glint on clouds; his role debated; check the signal against the rest.
detail: Open: U-y terms, U-aa sensitivity

items.title: Approve: How Mashtots designed the Armenian alphabet, and why anyone builds an alphabet from scratch (mashtots, 10 beats, ~1:59, script f34e45)
items.note: Write «ճնճղուկ» with one Greek letter per sound; author, year, first sentence; as far as possible one sound one letter (ու is two); the Greek order kept; letters as numbers; the script stayed.
detail: Open: U-ll wording, U-mm the classical sentence, how the voice reads «ճ»-ի / «ղ»-ի

items.title: Approve: Why English spelling is a mess (the Great Vowel Shift) (english_spelling, 8 beats, ~1:51, script abd4a4)
items.note: -ough read five ways; many silent letters were once pronounced; knight (consonants), house (vowel shift); printing froze spellings, borrowings and learned respellings too; Webster; 'not wrong, old'.
detail: Open: U-pp term, U-qq transliterations in the voice

items.title: Approve: Showcase 1: Public-key crypto explained with paint mixing (crypto_paint, 14 beats, ~2:45, script 6099db)
items.note: Agreeing a key in public: paint analogy (yellow + secret red / blue); Eva cannot unmix; numbers instead of paint, no known practical fast way back; toy numbers; authentication still needed.
detail: Open: U-p terms, U-q discrete logarithm, «գործնականում անհնար» (X44)

items.title: Approve: Long video: How strangers agree on a secret in public (16:9, paint and clocks) (crypto_long, 20 beats, ~5:01, script e0eef2)
items.note: Second long video (16:9): how strangers agree a secret in public: paint first, then clock arithmetic and the real exchange with 5 and 23 (both get 2); GCHQ had it first; Eva in the middle and certificates; quantum computers and the new exchanges.
detail: Decided: TTS voice, all three limits, Short kept, later slot. Open: LQ4 terms

items.title: Approve: Why yawning is contagious (yawning, 9 beats, ~1:49, script 7656ac)
items.note: About half catch a yawn; the oxygen idea failed; cooling theory; kin > strangers vs the null result; honestly, we do not know; how many times did you yawn?
detail: Open: U-dd «վարակվել», U-ee the comment call-to-action

items.title: Approve: Why the week has 7 days (week_seven, 9 beats, ~2:02, script f0aaab)
items.note: Sky gives day, month, year, not the week; the continuous week does not follow the Moon; Sabbath week (Armenian day names); planet days; 24 mod 7 draws the star; Soviet weeks failed.
detail: Open: U-ss ուրբաթ etymology, U-tt terms, U-uu Soviet detail

items.title: Approve: Short 4: Regression to the mean (why praise seems to "fail" and punishment seems to "work") (regression, 11 beats, ~2:23, script 489b49)
items.note: Kahneman's flight instructors; 1,000 simulated students: best 92 -> 82, worst 47 -> 59, and backwards; regression to the mean; a randomised comparison is the check.
detail: Open: «ռեգրեսիա դեպի միջինը», U-j «նախատինք»

items.title: Approve: The toothless man from Dmanisi (the oldest evidence of compassion?) (dmanisi, 9 beats, ~1:47, script 3e8edd)
items.note: Toothless man near Armenia; the 'someone fed him' story vs what the bone shows; a toothless bonobo; soft food, adaptation and help may all have played a part.
detail: Open: U-jj terms, «կարեկցանք» here vs in yawning (X54)

items.title: Approve: The IKEA effect (why you value furniture you built yourself more) (ikea_effect, 7 beats, ~1:23, script afa968)
items.note: Builders pay 63% more for their own box; crooked origami frogs; only if finished; it becomes 'my box'; maybe the same elsewhere (not measured); ask someone who did not build it.
detail: Open: U-aaa brand in the voice, U-bbb local touch

items.title: Approve: Why small kids get glued to CoComelon-style TV (kids_tv, 11 beats, ~2:45, script f98ea2)
items.note: Plausible mechanisms: the orienting reflex, bright fast shows, repetition; attention follows understanding; the 2011 study and the later fantastical-content experiments; WHO: no sedentary screens under 2, 1 hour at 2-4.
detail: Open: U-ff CoComelon meant?, U-hh terms

items.title: Approve: Short 3: Simpson's paradox ("better in every group, worse overall") (simpson, 12 beats, ~2:29, script 5b83ab)
items.note: Kidney stones: 78% vs 83% overall, higher in both groups; who got which treatment; the weighted average with the division by 350; Berkeley's six departments; compare like with like, no causal proof.
detail: Open: U-e «ֆակուլտետ», U-f method names

items.title: Approve: Why a minute has 60 seconds (minute_60, 6 beats, ~1:38, script 2f3bd2)
items.note: A real 10-hour French clock; base 60 is ancient (why, unknown); count to 60 on your hands; 60 divides well; minuta / secunda; why decimal time failed, we do not know for sure.
detail: Open: U-vv the Russian link

items.title: Approve: Why a wheeled suitcase is easier than a backpack (luggage_wheels, 7 beats, ~1:40, script 10fa6a)
items.note: Zero work on the load, yet you sweat: muscles use energy to hold a load, and walking lifts it each step; wheels take both away on a smooth floor; 'work is zero, energy is not'.
detail: Open: U-kkk Yerevan pavement joke, U-lll «բորտուղեկցորդ»

items.title: Approve: Short 5: Why waiting feels longer than it is, and how airports and Disney hide wait times (waiting, 8 beats, ~2:05, script 6cd7b0)
items.note: The same 8 minutes feel long or short; the Houston story (unverified); Maister's rules; Disney's posted waits; waiting is partly the clock, partly the feeling.
detail: Open: U-m «Մայստեր», U-o «ուղեբեռի ժապավեն»; queue maths parked as its own video

items.title: Approve: Showcase 3: Why the QWERTY layout won (messier than the "made to slow typists down" myth) (qwerty, 8 beats, ~1:50, script ff2590)
items.note: Not made to slow typists: telegraph operators shaped it, Remington built it, every new machine inherited it, down to the Armenian phonetic layout.
detail: Open: the spoken form «քվերթի» (X55), U-v terms
